about: Every Suno take made for this reel, kept so prompts and results can be compared and unused takes reused. Audio lives in the suno-archive release (archive links); suno_url opens the original at full quality.

takes.title: Unresolved A Minor
takes.note: Only take that goes near-silent on its own across the Crooked Room (15-20 s); in key with the A-tuned ring; end flows into start
takes.structure_cues:
[Intro: single soft piano notes over a low A drone]
[Build: cello enters, slow rising line, piano chords thicken gently]
[Break: near silence, only the drone and one high piano note]
[Theme: piano and cello together, calm, open fifths]
[Outro: suspended chord, held, fading, unresolved]
